definitions.gloss: mental aspect; psychological side; emotional dimension
definitions.explanation: The mental or psychological dimension of a person, activity, or situation, as opposed to the physical or technical aspects. Frequently used when discussing what makes someone strong, healthy, or successful beyond physical ability.

examples.japanese: {精神面|せいしんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧。

⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{精神面|せいしんめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}さ→強さ：25692_tsuyosa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勝敗|しょうはい}→勝敗：04905_shouhai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In sports, mental strength can determine victory or defeat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、{精神面|せいしんめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サポート→サポート：07776_sapooto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Recovery from illness requires not only physical strength but also psychological support.

notes:
USAGE:
{精神面|せいしんめん} is a compound of ⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧ (mind, spirit) and ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (aspect, side). It is commonly used to distinguish the psychological dimension from physical or technical aspects, particularly in sports, health, and education contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精神面|せいしんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧ (to train mentally)
- {精神面|せいしんめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}さ→強さ：25692_tsuyosa⟧ (mental strength)
- {精神面|せいしんめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サポート→サポート：07776_sapooto⟧ (psychological support)
- {精神面|せいしんめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧ (mental/emotional growth)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {精神面|せいしんめん}: mental aspect (used as a framework for discussion)
- ⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧: mental, psychological (adjectival, modifies nouns directly)
- {肉体面|にくたいめん}: physical aspect (the counterpart to {精神面|せいしんめん})
- ⟦メンタル→メンタル：11142_mentaru⟧: mental (loanword, casual)
